_comment: Export fidelity ledger. Shrink-only, with a staleness ratchet in test_export_ledger_is_not_stale. See tests/test_export_fidelity.py for what each list means.
_gaps_comment: Defects: attributes or elements a character LOSES on write. Empty, and meant to stay that way. A new entry here is a regression, not a discovery.
_matches_hd_comment: Diffs HERO DESIGNER ITSELF produces on a re-save, so reproducing them is fidelity, not damage. Never add one without the Java that does it. POWER:NAKEDMODIFIER|TEXT -- HD trims the attribute on restore (GenericObject.java:3623, textOutput = check.trim()), so a TEXT with a trailing space loses it in HD too. ADDER:IMMUNITY|BASECOST -- HD restores BASECOST from the document and then re-applies the selected option's cost over it (restoreFromSave ends by re-running setSelectedOption; Charges.java:549-551 shows the same pattern), so the in-memory baseCost is the option's 3.0 and that is what getSaveXML writes. Note this one is REASONED from the Java restore order rather than observed: confirming it needs HD to re-save the file, which the headless oracle CLI does not do -- it dumps costs. The cost side is confirmed, at 3.0, by 656/656 oracle parity.
